5461550.desc: 一款支援1–10人的第一人稱合作恐怖經營遊戲。接收超自然生物，採購用品、完成照顧小遊戲，將採集的原料加工成商品，推著貨箱穿過隨時可能停電的設施。用監控和廣播配合同事，研究收容物的習性與弱點，應對各自不同的出逃能力。在隨機來貨、波動行情和不斷上漲的公司營收要求之間，安排設施、擴充生產線，努力把這家公司經營到下一個班次。

3891660.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
3891660.desc: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.

3975350.name: 漢堡疊疊樂：誰是間諜
3975350.desc: 《漢堡疊疊樂：誰是間諜》是一款由3～6人合力疊起一個巨型漢堡的物理運算×身分隱藏派對遊戲。店員們同心協力完成料理，混在其中的間諜則隱藏身分，暗中把漢堡弄倒。剛剛那一下，真的不是故意的嗎？盡情享受合作與推理的樂趣吧！

2638080.name: Annihilated
2638080.desc: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

5061890.name: Scramshaw
5061890.desc: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.

3321550.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
3321550.desc: A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

5019800.name: System Arrival
5019800.desc: 俯視角生存動作 RPG，支援最多四人線上合作及雙人本機分割畫面。在被系統化為遊戲的世界中探索廢墟、以武器與靈能戰鬥、照顧倖存者並打造地下地堡，揭開系統真正的目的。
categories: 共享 / 分割螢幕合作
